title: 1906 Prairie's tower brought down to its 1898 picture
items: The Edson Keith house at 1906 Prairie now matches the Tribune's 1898 sketch of its front: the tower at its south end is broader and stops just above the cornice, the porch is wider, and a turned stone balustrade runs along the terraces and down the stoop. The mansard photograph long captioned 1906 is the house next door, at 1900.
